# book_location (Resource)

The location records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the location.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the location.

### Optional

- `code` (String) Code value attached to the location.
- `code_type` (String) Type of code attached to the location, for example QR.
- `description` (String) Free form notes about the location.
- `external_id` (String) Caller supplied identifier from an external system.
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude in decimal degrees.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude in decimal degrees.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent location id for nested locations.
- `type` (String) Location type, for example building, floor, room.
